status: frozen before candidate acquisition, reconstruction, and truth scoring
scope: SIMULATED paired development comparison on the same nine previously inspected D003 scenes; not holdout and not physical validation
purpose: Test the falsifiable hypothesis that moving four level diagonal views inward while retaining one identical central view expands accepted-return hull support to the full 20x20 grid under the unchanged D003 estimator.
current_stop_boundary: After acquisition validation and before reconstruction or volume scoring

captures.source: archived baseline_fixed1-1.bin; byte-identical fixed3-1.bin alias checked
archived baseline_fixed1-1.bin; byte-identical fixed3-1.bin alias checked

paired_design.only_arm_difference: XY coordinates of the four diagonal views

geometric_preregistration.interpretation: Development prediction only; enclosing grid centers does not guarantee accepted returns, TIN support, or volume accuracy.

estimator.registration: Use decoded world XYZ supplied by each frame pose; pool all usable returns before one XY triangulation.
estimator.merge_rule: Round XY to the nearest fixed 0.5 mm bin in deterministic order. Retain median measured XYZ only when observed Z range is <= 0.003 m; otherwise withhold the cluster as a conflict.
estimator.triangulation: scipy.spatial.Delaunay over merged XY with qhull_options Qbb Qc Qz Q12; simplices sorted deterministically before rasterization
estimator.raster: Same grid centers, known base subtraction, below-reference threshold and barycentric interpolation conventions as server.geometry; average multiple accepted triangle contributions per cell.
estimator.total_eligibility: 400/400 supported cells, zero invalid frames, zero unavailable input views, no Qhull error and no input points omitted in Delaunay.coplanar

assessment.primary_coverage_gate: Candidate must be total-eligible with 400/400 supported cells in all 9 scenes.
assessment.company_gate_after_independent_release: For total-eligible results only, all 9 candidate scenes must have absolute relative whole-volume error <= 0.05 before reserved validation may be prepared.
assessment.partial_policy: Unsupported cells are never zero-filled; partial estimates are never approved totals.
truth_metrics_after_independent_release: total signed and absolute volume error for total-eligible results only
integrated absolute cell-volume error and cancellation ratio on own and common domains
unsupported exact volume in evaluator only

interpretation_limits: All scenes and the control acquisition were previously inspected; this is development evidence, not independent validation.
The candidate coordinates were chosen with knowledge of development scenes, so even a 9/9 result cannot replace reserved or physical validation.
Global Delaunay can join points across a discontinuity or occluded gap even when every triangle edge is <=0.10 m.
TIN support is interpolation support, not directly observed area.
Ideal center rays omit finite-zone optics, noise, multipath, registration error, and hardware effects.
A low net total error can result from cancellation and must be read with integrated absolute spatial error.
